body: Develop high-performance mobile applications using Flutter and native iOS technologies with clean architecture, responsive UI, and scalable codebases.
Build modern, fast, and production-ready web applications focused on performance, usability, and maintainable system design.
Implement secure authentication flows, protected API integrations, user access management, and scalable backend communication for reliable digital products.
Integrate Apple technologies including HealthKit, Apple Watch, and iOS native services to create seamless connected experiences within the Apple ecosystem.
